title: Add work

pending.title: Pending uploads
pending.stalledHint: No new pages from OCR for over 30 minutes — the job may have stalled. Check the OCR server if needed.

step1.title: Work metadata
step1.yearHint: If the exact year is unknown, enter an approximate year. A display range (e.g. "ca. 1680") can be configured later in metadata.
step1.slugConflict: Folder data/{{slug}}/ already exists — change the slug
step1.timeEstimate: Upload and OCR processing duration depends on page count (approx. 2–3 pages/min).
step1.materialTypeHandYearHint: For manuscripts, dating is often approximate or unknown — leave the year empty or enter a range (e.g. early 17th c.).

step2.title: Upload PDF or images
step2.dropzone: Drag PDF, JPG or PNG here, or click to select files
step2.accepted: PDF received, transferring to OCR server...
step2.waitNote: This may take a few minutes.
step2.canLeaveNote: Upload and OCR processing runs in the background — this takes {{time}}. You can safely leave this page and return later, your progress is saved.
step2.multipleImagesNote: Multiple images are uploaded sequentially — do not close this page.
step2.collectingImages: Images not fully uploaded — please select all files again.

step3.title: Review
step3.canLeaveNote: OCR processing runs in the background — this takes {{time}}. You can safely leave this page and return later, your progress is saved. You can also click "Close" below to start adding the next work right away.
step3.editMetaTitle: Fill in metadata while OCR is running
step3.editMetaNote: Data is saved to staging and will be imported with the work.
step3.importDisabledOcr: Wait for OCR to finish processing all pages
step3.timeoutWarning: OCR processing is taking a long time. You can import the available pages.
step3.gitCommitWarning: Work was imported, but the Git version-control commit failed.

notice.title: Upload and processing takes {{time}}
notice.body: After adding the PDF, OCR processing runs in the background. You can leave this page and return later — your progress is saved automatically.

cancelConfirm: Are you sure? The upload will be cancelled and all data deleted.

errors.fileTooLarge: File is too large (max 500 MB). For very large files, upload as individual images.
errors.invalidPdf: Invalid PDF — file cannot be read

replaceWork.label: Replace existing work
replaceWork.warning: Replacement will delete all existing pages and replace them with new ones.
